title: khalofx/noncodingdrivers pipeline parameters
description: Cohort-level discovery and explanation of candidate non-coding regulatory driver elements from pre-called somatic variants

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: Comma-separated file with a header row and the columns sample, entry, cohort, cancer_type, assembly, mutations, vcf, index and maf (see the usage documentation). Rows sharing a cohort are merged into one cohort table.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_options.title: Reference options
reference_options.description: Reference files. The datasheet assets/references/<genome>.yml supplies all of them; an explicit parameter wins over the datasheet value.

genome.help_text: The datasheet lists the validated GRCh38 reference set with checksums. Paths in it start with ${reference_base}.

references.description: Custom reference datasheet (YAML, assets/schema_references.json) instead of assets/references/<genome>.yml.

reference_base.description: Directory that the ${reference_base} paths of the datasheet are relative to.
reference_base.help_text: Without it, datasheet entries that start with ${reference_base} stay unset and the matching parameters must be given explicitly.

elements_bed.description: Element catalogue: headerless BED with chrom, start, end and element id (>= 4 columns), GRCh38 chr-named.
elements_bed.help_text: Use the coding-sequence-excluded catalogue (Ensembl Regulatory Build with GENCODE CDS removed); a CDS-included catalogue leaks coding selection into the non-coding test. Rows sharing an element id are fragments of one element: they are tested together and reported as one span with n_fragments.

fasta.description: GRCh38 FASTA with UCSC contig names (chr1..chr22, chrX, chrY); needed for vcf, sarek and maf rows.
fasta.help_text: The .fai index must sit beside it unless --fasta_fai is given.

fasta_dict.description: Sequence dictionary of --fasta (samtools dict); needed by Picard LiftoverVcf (default: <fasta without extension>.dict).

rename_chrs.description: bcftools --rename-chrs map to the UCSC contig names of --fasta (default: datasheet rename_map).

input_harmonisation_options.title: Input harmonisation options
input_harmonisation_options.description: vcf, sarek and maf rows: assembly check and opt-in hg19 liftover.

assembly_min_match.description: Minimum fraction of REF alleles that must match the FASTA of the declared assembly; a row below it stops the run (ASSEMBLY_MISMATCH).

assembly_min_records.description: Rows with fewer checkable SNVs keep their declared assembly with a low_evidence warning.

allow_hg19_liftover.description: Lift GRCh37/hg19 vcf, sarek and maf rows to GRCh38 with Picard LiftoverVcf; rejected records are published.
allow_hg19_liftover.help_text: Without it, GRCh37/hg19 rows stop the run (ASSEMBLY_NOT_ENABLED).

liftover_source_fasta.description: UCSC hg19 FASTA (chr-named) for the build check and MAF conversion of GRCh37/hg19 rows (default: datasheet liftover_source_fasta).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

run_oncodrivefml.description: Run OncodriveFML (functional-impact bias). Licence-gated: also set --accept_oncodrivefml_licence.
run_oncodrivefml.help_text: OncodriveFML is AGPL-3.0 software whose rights holder, Universitat Pompeu Fabra, permits academic, non-commercial and personal use only without a separate licence (see the OncodriveFML README). It also needs a user-supplied functional-impact score track (--oncodrivefml_score).

accept_oncodrivefml_licence.description: Confirm that your use of OncodriveFML and of the score track complies with their licence terms.

oncodrivefml_score.description: bgzip-compressed, tabix-indexed functional-impact score track (CADD GRCh38 v1.7 whole-genome SNVs); the .tbi must sit beside it.
oncodrivefml_score.help_text: CADD scores are free for non-commercial use only and are never bundled with the pipeline. The OncodriveFML configuration (--oncodrivefml_conf) names this file by its basename.

oncodrivefml_conf.description: OncodriveFML configuration file (score columns, sampling, seed, cores). Default: assets/oncodrivefml.CADD_GRCh38.conf (CADD GRCh38 v1.7 PHRED).

oncodrivefml_genome.description: Offline bgdata hg38 genome for OncodriveFML: a directory or a .tar.gz of it. Empty means bgdata downloads its own copy.
oncodrivefml_genome.help_text: Compute nodes without internet access need this (bgdata hg38-20161209). A .tar.gz is unpacked by the nf-core untar module.

adwgs_shard_size.help_text: Elements are tested in shards so that a failing element loses only its shard; FDR is recomputed over all shards, so the value does not change p- or q-values.

run_mutenricher.description: Run MutEnricher as a QC caller (mutation burden). Its native table is published and never enters the p-value combination.
run_mutenricher.help_text: MutEnricher reads per-sample PASS VCFs, which the vcf, sarek and maf entry tiers provide; mutations-tier cohorts are not run through it. Its element p-values correlate with ActiveDriverWGS, so it replicates the burden test rather than adding independent evidence.

mutenricher_mappable_regions.description: GRCh38 callable/mappable regions BED for MutEnricher, BGZF-compressed, with its .tbi beside it.

consensus_options.title: Consensus options
consensus_options.description: P-value combination (COMBINEPVALUES): EBM, ACAT, RRA and votes are always published; --combination_method selects consensus_q.

combination_method.description: Combination that sets consensus_q and is_consensus: empirical Brown (ebm, default) or ACAT (acat).

fdr_threshold.description: BH q-value threshold for consensus candidates.

skip_acat.description: Do not compute ACAT (use when the ACAT package is unavailable, e.g. -profile conda). Not allowed with --combination_method acat.

variant_flags_options.title: Variant flag options
variant_flags_options.description: Mask and germline flags of every mutation row and their element-level fractions (VARIANT_FLAGS). Flag, never filter: the mutation table, the callers and the consensus are unchanged.

run_variant_flags.description: Flag every mutation row with the ENCODE Blacklist v2, GIAB segdup and low-mappability masks, Umap k100 uniqueness and gnomAD germline frequency; aggregate per element with the callable fraction.
run_variant_flags.help_text: The masks and the gnomAD archive come from the reference datasheet (--reference_base) unless given explicitly. Outputs: variant_flags/<cohort>.variant_flags.tsv and variant_flags/<cohort>.element_flags.tsv.

blacklist_bed.description: ENCODE Blacklist v2 for hg38 (BED, UCSC names). Default: datasheet blacklist_bed.

segdup_bed.description: GIAB v3.6 GRCh38 segmental duplications (GRCh38_segdups.bed.gz). Default: datasheet segdup_bed.

low_mappability_bed.description: GIAB v3.6 GRCh38 low-mappability regions (GRCh38_lowmappabilityall.bed.gz). Default: datasheet low_mappability_bed.

umap_bed.description: Umap k100 single-read mappability regions for hg38 (k100.umap.bed.gz). Default: datasheet umap_bed.
umap_bed.help_text: Uniquely mappable sequence. umap_unique_fraction is the covered fraction of each variant; the callable territory of an element is this file minus the ENCODE Blacklist v2.

gnomad_echtvar.description: gnomAD v4.1 genomes echtvar archive with the fields gnomad_filter, gnomad_af and gnomad_fafmax_faf95_max. Default: datasheet gnomad_echtvar.
gnomad_echtvar.help_text: Built once with nf-core echtvar/encode from the official per-chromosome sites VCFs (recipe in docs/references.md).

skip_germline_flags.description: Do not annotate gnomAD germline frequencies: the germline columns are NA.

germline_faf_threshold.description: germline_pop_common is true when the gnomAD FILTER is PASS and fafmax_faf95_max (grpmax FAF95) is above this value.

evidence_options.title: Evidence options
evidence_options.description: PCAWG-style post-filter flags and the long-form evidence table (POSTFILTERFLAGS, WRITEDRIVEREVIDENCE). Evidence tiers are assigned downstream, not by the pipeline.

run_driver_evidence.description: Write post-filter flags (postfilter/<cohort>.postfilter.tsv) and the long-form evidence table (evidence/<cohort>.driver_evidence.tsv).
run_driver_evidence.help_text: One row per cohort x element x evidence item with value, unit, status, threshold, source, source_version and native_or_lifted; validated layout in assets/schema_driver_evidence.json. The consensus is never filtered or re-ranked.

postfilter_mode.description: flag_only keeps the q-values; pcawg adds q_postfilter (failing elements set to p = 1 before Benjamini-Hochberg) and never overwrites consensus_q.

postfilter_min_mutations.description: Minimum support: mutations in the element.

postfilter_min_patients.description: Minimum support: patients with a mutation in the element.

postfilter_min_mappable_fraction.description: Mappability: the share of the element's mutations outside GIAB low-mappability regions must be above this.

postfilter_max_sample_fraction.description: Maximum sample fraction: the largest share of the element's mutations from one patient must not be above this.

evidence_scope.description: Elements written to the evidence table: nominal (any caller or combination p < 0.01, or consensus_q < 0.25) or all.

null_calibration_options.title: Null calibration options
null_calibration_options.description: Per-caller calibration on neutral copies of each cohort (NULL_CALIBRATION; in-house, off by default). Reported only: no p- or q-value is changed.

run_null_calibration.description: Re-run the callers on SIMULATENULL copies of each cohort and report the per-method inflation factor, q < FDR counts and QQ points.
run_null_calibration.help_text: Each SNV moves to a random position with the same trinucleotide within +/- --null_window bases, in the same patient (the PCAWG Sanger null); non-SNV rows are not carried. Each replicate costs about as much as the observed run. Needs the GRCh38 FASTA.

null_window.description: Half-width (bases) of the window within which each SNV is moved.

null_lambda_band.description: Band of the null inflation factor, low,high. A method with a replicate above it is reported excluded_for_inflation; below it, conservative.

seed.description: Random seed of the null simulation: replicate r uses seed + r.

annotation_options.title: Annotation options
annotation_options.description: Annotation layers on the significant elements and their candidate mutations (EXPLAIN). None of them filters or re-ranks a candidate.

gencode_gtf.description: GENCODE GTF (GRCh38, chr-named or Ensembl-named). Its gene records give the TSSs of the nearest-gene table.
gencode_gtf.help_text: A gene's TSS is its start on the + strand and its end on the - strand, for every gene biotype. The TSS BED built from it is published under references/ and can be reused with --gene_tss_bed.

gene_tss_bed.description: Pre-built sorted gene TSS BED (chrom, tss-1, tss, gene_id, 0, strand, gene_name, gene_type), used instead of --gencode_gtf.

run_regulatory_context.description: Report ENCODE peak overlap (peak count, covered bases, maximum signal) of each significant element per tissue and layer.

regulatory_peaks_dir.description: Folder with one sub-folder per tissue holding <layer>.<accession>.bed.gz peak files (narrowPeak or DNase hotspot).
regulatory_peaks_dir.help_text: A layer that is not staged for a tissue is absent from the output table, never reported as zero.

run_vep.description: Annotate candidate mutations with Ensembl VEP from an offline cache (consequences, gnomAD genome AF). --regulatory is never used.

vep_cache.description: Offline Ensembl VEP cache directory (holding homo_sapiens/<version>_GRCh38).

vep_cache_version.description: Ensembl VEP cache release (116 = GENCODE v50).

run_motifbreakr.description: Score candidate SNVs for transcription-factor motif disruption and creation with motifbreakR (annotation and hypothesis only).

jaspar_motifs.description: JASPAR-format PFM file for motifbreakR. Default: assets/motifs/jaspar_core_vertebrates_2026.pfm (JASPAR 2026 CORE vertebrates, 1,019 profiles).

run_sigprofiler.description: Optional cohort-level QC: SigProfiler mutational-signature extraction and per-sample exposures. Slow; nothing downstream uses it.

sigprofiler_genome.description: Pre-installed SigProfilerMatrixGenerator GRCh38 genome, for compute nodes without internet.
